items.title: Dalen Terry is not two-way eligible
items.author: Dalton Johnson
items.body_excerpt:
Dalen Terry is not two-way eligible

On an Exhibit 10 contract he’ll come to training camp with the Warriors, play preseason and most likely will wind up in Santa Cruz 

Terry, a 6-6 point guard, turned 24 in July and was the No. 18 pick in the 2022 NBA Draft 

Nice upside swing

items.title: The Golden State Warriors and Dalen Terry have agreed to a deal, league sources told HoopsHype. Terry, the 18th pick of the 2022 NBA Draft, has played four combined NBA seasons with the Chicago Bulls and Philadelphia 76ers.
items.author: Michael Scotto
